_note: Series trails. Each series collects posts by blog category ('category') or by a pattern in the title ('title'), oldest first. 'from'/'to' limit the dates. Edit the descriptions freely. 'include' adds any story by its address (blog path or Substack link); 'exclude' drops one. 'cover' picks the series' main photo.
